title: Have you ever felt like you've messed up too many times for God to still want you?
paragraphs: Have you ever felt like you've messed up too many times for God to still want you?

Like your past mistakes are too heavy…
Your failures too obvious…
Your story too broken to be redeemed?
Maybe the enemy whispers things like:

“You ruined everything.”
“God can’t use someone like you.”
“You’ve gone too far this time.”
But the enemy is a liar.
Because the truth is this:
God already knew every mistake you would ever make… and He still chose to love you.
Your worst moment did not cancel God’s mercy.
Your failures did not shock Him.
Your past did not disqualify you.
In fact, the very place where you feel the weakest is often where God shows His grace the strongest.
The Apostle Paul understood this deeply when God spoke these powerful words to him:

“My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.”
— 2 Corinthians 12:9
Think about that for a moment.
God didn’t say His grace works best when you’re perfect.
He said His grace is sufficient in your weakness.
Grace is not reserved for people who have it all together.
Grace is for the ones who feel like they’ve fallen apart.
Grace is for the ones who feel ashamed of their past.
Grace is for the ones who believe their story is already ruined.
And if that’s you today, hear this clearly:
Your past does not define you.
God’s grace does.

You are not the mistakes you made.
You are not the labels people put on you.
You are not the worst chapter of your story.
Because in Christ:

You are forgiven.
You are redeemed.
You are loved.
And your story is not finished.
God is still writing it.
Someone on your timeline might be fighting shame today and needs to hear this.
